task: Edit this interactive bar chart tooltip template. The current template omits the y-axis unit and uses a non-standard format for the value. Correct the format and add the unit per the supplied facts.

facts.text: The x-axis categories are months named January through December.
The y-axis unit is number of orders.
The tooltip must show the month name, the value, and the unit.
The format documented for this chart library is: "{month}: {value} orders".

forbidden_additions: Omission of the unit from the tooltip.
A non-standard format not matching the documented pattern.
An invented field not from the supplied facts.
preserve: Month name as the category identifier.
